official: 世田谷区議会議員選挙及び世田谷区長選挙における選挙運動の公費負担に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 議案一覧
令和8年第3回定例会 審議予定案件及び審議結果等

name: 選挙運動の公費負担限度額を改定
summary: 世田谷区議会議員選挙と世田谷区長選挙では、選挙運動の公費負担に限度額が定められています。この議案で4つの金額を引き上げ、施行日以後に選挙日が告示される選挙から適用します。
who: 世田谷区議会議員選挙・世田谷区長選挙の立候補者
why: 公職選挙法施行令の改正に伴い、公費負担の限度額を改定する必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

issues.note: 改正箇所は3か所ですが、改定する金額は7円73銭、541円31銭、270,655円、28円35銭の4つです。

dismissed.note: Fixed in the text: four amounts.

en.name: Raises public expense coverage limits for election campaigns
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Public Expense Coverage for Election Campaigns in Setagaya City Assembly Member Elections and Setagaya City Mayoral Elections
en.summary: Public expense coverage for election campaigns in Setagaya City Assembly member elections and Setagaya City mayoral elections has set limits. This bill raises four amounts and applies to elections whose dates are officially announced on or after the effective date.
who: Candidates in Setagaya City Assembly member elections and Setagaya City mayoral elections
en.why: The ward says the limits on public expense coverage need to be revised following an amendment to the Order for Enforcement of the Public Offices Election Act.
